purpose: Explain uncertainty and cap-driven changes across the completed research window, including failures and the independently failed confirmation. Do not change fixed stopping decisions.
scope: Completed formal paired generation arms in the position, confidence-only, matched-first confirmation, feedback, positive-branch, progression and radial batches. Exclude engineering outputs, wrong-layer outputs and hypothetical prefix-stop totals from generation-effect estimates. Keep SEAL/AIME comparison separate from optimization screening.
metrics: Original and candidate accuracy, thinking and total tokens, caps, paired correctness changes, recorded pure generation time.
10000 paired bootstrap resamples, seed20260923, for accuracy difference and ratio changes in mean thinking/total tokens; resample complete questions with both outputs together.
Exact decomposition of net total-token change by cap transitions and correctness transitions. These outcome-conditioned groups are descriptive, not an online selection rule or deployable policy.
controls: Include every predeclared control for three-arm designs. Never compare absolute scores across different question sets or pool distinct interventions into one effect.
interpretation: Intervals are descriptive conditional on these questions, assets and a single generation seed; they do not include cross-seed, model or calibration uncertainty.
Bootstrap intervals are not adjusted for multiple comparisons and do not turn a failed fixed gate into a pass.
A cap-transition decomposition can show why an average changed, but membership uses realized outcomes and cannot support an inference-time gate.
Small-screen positive signals and their independent confirmation must remain separately labeled.
cost: Local existing JSON and NumPy only. Zero GPU calls, new generations or regrading. Record all input and output hashes.
